source_facts.openpi_split_semantics: When EMA exists, train_state retains live params and optimizer state while the separate params item contains EMA params.

b1_design.name: SERIAL_LARGE_ITEM_COMPOSITE_CHECKPOINT
b1_design.implementation: Wrap the two PyTree handlers in synchronous blocking CheckpointHandler adapters so CompositeCheckpointHandler completes one large item before starting the other. Preserve item names, PyTreeCheckpointHandler, OCDBT/default format, assets callback, and CheckpointManager layout.
b1_design.limiter_selection: One independently reviewed fixed value. 8GB exceeds the observed 4.831838208GB single request and is not a post-result ladder.

roundtrip_validation.save_process: Generate canonical state-dict per-leaf SHA256 fingerprints before save, then perform the B1 serial save and exit to release GPU memory.
roundtrip_validation.restore_process: In a separate CPU/NumPy process, restore train_state and params from checkpoint metadata, recompute per-leaf SHA256 fingerprints, and require exact match.

if_pass: Stop qualification and design a separate fresh formal run3 authority using the same B1 implementation. Run3 is not authorized by this source adjudication.
if_fail: Stop B1. Candidate B2 chunked-D2H remains fallback only and requires another independent review before execution.
